text: I can classify a message as a command or an event from its name, recipients and whether it can be rejected.
I can choose between event notification and event-carried state transfer and state what each costs.
I can explain event sourcing, snapshots, and why CQRS read models usually come with it but don't require it.
I can draw both dual-write failure timelines (commit then failed publish, publish then failed commit).
I can implement a transactional outbox with a relay and explain why consumers must still deduplicate.
I can explain how a CDC tool like Debezium reads the Postgres WAL or MySQL binlog, and when CDC beats a polling relay.
